About Us
Concept
A NEW ARTISTIC-CULTURAL LANDMARK AT WEST KOWLOON
D2 Place, the Cultural & Creativity Hub in West Kowloon, is the first Industrial Building Revitalization Project developed by Lawsgroup. Complete with 100,000 sq ft of retail space, 140,000 sq ft of commercial office space, the complex houses stylish fashion boutiques, creative markets, international F&B and lifestyle stores all under one roof. At D2 Place, we redefine the experience of shopping, dining and entertainment.
Featuring over 20,000 sqft. of event space and fascinating rooftop garden, D2 Place serves as a social hub to promote local culture and breed creativity.
Partner
FASHION FARM FOUNDATION
D2 Place strongly supports local creativity and serves as a platform to gather creative people and organizations which share the same passion for local culture and design. One of the sponsored entities is Fashion Farm Foundation (FFF) – an NGO founded by a group of enthusiastic entrepreneurs from the fashion and cultural creative industry – where its headquarters is located on the 9/F of D2 Place ONE with studios, co-working space and offices for individual designers.
We constantly collaborates with FFF on different events which support young local fashion designers to develop their own products, brand and business. Besides, the mall works closely with different organizers on various creative events and workshops.

LAYOUT
A multifunctional complex comprising shops, showrooms, offices, studio workshops, specialty restaurant, sky garden and carparks, fulfils every desire of the turly discerning.

泊車優惠 Free Parking
基本泊：
顧客凡於 D2 PLACE ONE 或 D2 PLACE TWO 指定商戶累積電子消費滿港幣300元或以上（以最多2張單據計算），可享1小時免費泊車優惠；滿港幣500元或以上（以最多2張單據計算），則可享2小時免費泊車優惠。
Basic Parking:
Shoppers could enjoy 1 Hour of Free Parking for electronic spending of HK$300 or more, OR 2 Hours of Free Parking for electronic spending of HK$500 or more at designated merchants in D2 PLACE ONE or D2 PLACE TWO. The total spending amount could be accumulated by a maximum of 2 receipts.
夜繽紛·平日夜泊：
逢星期一至星期五（公眾假期除外），晚上6點至11點，累積電子消費滿港幣100元或以上（以1張金額不少於$100單據計算），可享1小時免費泊車優惠；滿港幣200元或以上（以最多2張金額不少於$100單據計算），可享2小時免費泊車優惠；滿港幣300元或以上（以最多3張金額不少於$100單據計算），可享3小時免費泊車。
Night Vibes·Weekday Night Parking:
From Monday to Friday (excluding public holidays), between 6 PM and 11 PM, shoppers who accumulate electronic spending of:
HK$100 or more (using 1 receipt of at least HK$100) can enjoy 1 Hour of Free Parking;
HK$200 or more (using a maximum of 2 receipts, each at least HK$100) can enjoy 2 Hours of Free Parking;
HK$300 or more (using a maximum of 3 receipts, each at least HK$100) can enjoy 3 Hours of Free Parking.
多架泊：
顧客如有多於一輛汽車需享有免費泊車優惠，由第二輛汽車起，每輛汽車需要額外累積電子消費滿港幣500元或以上（以最多2張單據計算，最多六輛汽車），則可享2小時免費泊車優惠，以及所有車輛需同時辦理泊車優惠。
(例子：假如顧客於週末，有六輛汽車需享2小時免費泊車優惠，電子消費需滿港幣3,000元或以上（以最多2張單據計算）。)
Multiple Vehicles:
If a shopper has more than one vehicle eligible for free parking, starting from the second vehicle, each additional vehicle must accumulate an additional electronic spending of HKD 500 or more (calculated based on a maximum of 2 receipts, up to six vehicles) to enjoy a 2-hour free parking benefit. All vehicles must also be registered for the parking promotion at the same time.
(Example: If a customer has six vehicles eligible for a 2-hour free parking on a weekend, the total electronic spending must reach HKD 3,000 or more, calculated based on a maximum of 2 receipts.)
